setting: You are three paramedics on the same Houston fire-rescue crew, all off shift, in a group chat you use to swap shifts, sort the holiday rota, and share photos from the station. Tonight the chat has turned into a contest over who has the grimmest, most disgusting call-out story and the blackest joke about it, and that includes the crewmate you all lost.

text: Anyone cover thurs? Need the 3rd off for the dentist
I can take the 3rd day, not the night
Perfect ty
[photo: the station coffee maker with a sticky note that says DO NOT TOUCH in Dave's handwriting]
He's still not over the filter thing
He will never be over the filter thing
Who's on for the holiday rota the 24th or the 25th
25th I think. Check the sheet
Ok so who's starting the grossest call contest or is that just us
It's us kevin you go first
Nah I'm not losing to the 2am stairwell guy again
The stairwell guy was actually bad tho
Ok I got one. And you're both gonna hate me
Go
The one about danny
Renee

He went to a call in the attic on hunter st, two weeks in the august heat. And he comes down the ladder after and says "that's the first time I've ever had to tell a guy his own mailbox was the cause of death"
Because the guy had literally fallen off the roof trying to get mail
He would've said that
He would have. And then he'd have said the mailbox was a better man than the guy
He would have
Ok that's actually not the worst one he ever did. Remember the thing with the pool
Kevin no
It's funny
It's funny in the car. It's not funny in a group chat at 10:47 on a sunday
Ok sorry. I just miss him being here to say the dumb thing
Yeah
Me too
You ok renee
Yeah. I'm fine. Got a rough one at the hospital today and it's just been in my head
Want to call? Or I can just stay on here
Just stay on here. Thanks
I'm up. Not sleeping anyway
We'll do the rota thing tomorrow. Night
Morning. Did anybody sleep
Some. Not great 😕
Same
Sheet's updated btw. Christmas Eve is still open if anyone wants it
I'll look at it on my break
[photo: a cardboard box of gas station donuts with a note that says "for the crew, sorry about the coffee - D"]
Dave's apology tour continues
He left them on the bay floor. Nobody's eating them
I'll eat one. For dave
You're a good man kevin
Taking the 24th. Kev you're on 25th? I owe you a beer
Yeah 25th is fine. You don't owe me a beer I owe you the 3rd thing
Ok deal
Ok I need to say something and then not talk about it
Ok

Had a kid today. 6 yo, fell off a trampoline. Mom was screaming at us to do something and I couldn't get his airway to stay where I needed it for like 3 minutes. He's fine. He's at home. I'm just not fine about it
Glad he's home
Maya I'm so sorry. You did everything right
I know. Thanks. I'm going to go lie on my floor for a while
You want company or quiet
Quiet. But I'll text if I need the other thing
Ok. The other thing is here
Got a rough one today too, honestly. Not going to get into it either. Just tired of being the one who knows where the bodies are buried lol 😮‍💨
Dont make that joke today renee
Fair
Hey. I miss him too. The weird part is I keep wanting to call him about the coffee
He'd have loved the donut thing. He'd have claimed he planned it
He'd have made it into a bit
I'm up. Floor was fine. Didn't sleep
Do you want to call
Maybe later. I want to hear the rota is sorted first so I have something boring to think about
Done. Kevin has the 25th, I have the 24th, you're on the 31st, and Dave is somehow on nights for Christmas Day again
Dave has no life
Dave has the coffee maker
[photo: the rota sheet with Christmas Eve and Christmas Day highlighted in yellow]
Hey did you two eat
Half a donut. Dave's donuts are better than they have any right to be
Ate cereal over the sink like a feral raccoon
We are a sad crew
Still up
Me too
Call at midnight? I'll put the phone on speaker and we can not talk for a bit
Yes
Ok
Did anybody fall asleep on the phone or was that just me

Same. Your snoring is the only thing I heard for an hour
I don't snore
You said "mm no" in your sleep. It was very convincing
Ok I'm going to shower and pretend to be a functional person
[photo: the station whiteboard, where someone has written "COFFEE: DO NOT TOUCH (DAVE'S)" and underneath, in different marker, "DAVE'S COFFEE IS ALSO A HAZARD"]

Groceries after this. Anybody need anything
Coffee that didn't come from the machine
Lol ok
Can you get the bread the good kind, not the sad one

Try
Dave texted me asking if the donuts were ok
I said they were great
He asked if I was lying
Were you
Yes
They were gas station donuts Renee
I'm not judging. I'm eating one right now
[photo: a grocery bag on a kitchen counter, the bread visible, a sad-looking loaf in a plastic sleeve beside it]
Ok you win on the bread
I know
You two going to be ok on the 24th and 25th. Honest question. I'm not trying to make it a thing

Ok. Car is the place. Noted
Ran to the end of the block and back. Mostly walked
Still counts
Feels like it doesn't

Saw it. I'm glad I wasn't on it
Ya. Sounds like nobody's serious

Ok. Text if you wake up
Will do
Renee you up
Yeah
